ten_predecessor_checks.old_topic_sample: Classify the individual, residence, citizenship, income source, legal activity and actual regime before calculating Moldova's 2026 income tax. This source-cited draft covers ordinary annual individual liability, registered business/professional income, final withholding, capital gains and the separate retail, plant-purchasing and independent-service regimes. It replaces the old 2025 summary, not the need for the correct underlying documents. Bounded source review is recorded under Sources; accountant attestation is not provided. [Fiscal Code arts. 5, 13–15, 39–44, 69^1–69^26, 83][code].

Compute ordinary resident-company profit tax and the separate eligible non-VAT SME income regime for 2026. Establish the taxpayer, elected regime and applicable period before calculating. Resident business entities include income from Moldova and abroad, less the deductions and exemptions they actually qualify for. Legal persons use accrual accounting. This is a source-cited draft, without accountant attestation or comprehensive country coverage. [Fiscal Code arts. 13–14, 44][code].

Compute Moldova's 2026 ordinary employment withholding, employer social contributions and employee medical premiums using the employee's actual status, gross components, accrual period, payment dates and exemption application. This is a source-cited draft. The bounded source-review record is linked under Sources; accountant attestation is not provided. [Fiscal Code arts. 15, 19, 88][code]; [Government Decision 697/2014, 2026 regulation][reg].

Use this Guide to compare an ordinary Moldovan business, the eligible non-VAT small-business regime and an actual IT-park resident, and to evaluate company distributions and genuine independent work. Establish legal eligibility before comparing amounts. An SRL, an individual entrepreneur and the new registered independent service entrepreneur are different legal/tax populations; an invoice or a software-related description does not select a regime. This is a source-cited draft, with stated implementation gaps and a bounded source-review record linked under Sources. [Code arts. 13–15, 24(11^1), 54^1–54^4, 88, 368][code]; [Law 77/2016 arts. 2, 7–8][park].

Determine the actual payer category, insured person, remuneration, work period and payment date before calculating Moldova's 2026 social contributions or mandatory medical insurance. These are different systems with different bases and timing. This source-cited draft replaces the earlier mixed-year summary. It has a bounded source-review record linked under Sources and is not accountant-attested; the country remains partial. [Law 489/1999 arts. 17–23][social]; [Law 1593/2002][health].

Use this Guide to prepare an ordinary Moldovan SRL incorporation, compare the individual-entrepreneur registration route and screen an SA proposal. It supplies the current registration and continuing-compliance framework as read on 30 October 2026. It does not certify the full securities-registration procedure, regulated-sector approvals, every foreign-document treaty exemption or historical incorporation rules throughout 2026. The bounded source-review record is linked under Sources. [Law 135/2007 arts. 2, 9, 11–16][srl]; [Law 220/2007 arts. 7–14, 28, 35][register]; [Law 1134/1997 arts. 2–4, 38][sa].

This Guide covers ordinary resident foreign income and nonresident Moldova-source income: residence, permanent establishments (PEs), gross withholding, property and capital gains, treaty evidence and refunds, foreign-tax credits, and individual arrival/departure. It is a source-cited draft. The country pack remains partial because of the identified implementation gaps. A named accountant has not attested to this expansion.

Use this overview to identify the taxpayer, period, tax base and connected Moldova Guide before calculating an ordinary 2026 liability. Headline rates are not a complete tax computation or proof of eligibility for a special regime. The pack remains a source-cited draft with stated gaps and a bounded source-review record linked under Sources. [Code arts. 12^1–15, 83, 96, 114–115][code].

2026 draft, primary law read 30 October 2026; the current information annex and APA application model read 31 October 2026. The 24 October draft and its independent correction evidence are preserved; that review does not attest to this expanded country pack. This Guide provides the domestic TP computation/documentation method. Actual comparables, legal facts and any treaty relief must be evidenced before use.

2026 draft, law read 30–31 October 2026. Use alongside `vat-workflow-base` v0.1 or later for document handling. The Moldova law and current return instructions control the tax calculation. The bounded source-review record is linked under Sources; accountant attestation is not provided.
